description: Lists the records in this project's .signafaide/ folder, newest first, and searches them by agent, by time window, or by record hash. Use it to see what was recorded: which tool calls, by which agent, when, and how far each record has got. Returns one line per record with its time, agent, sequence number, kind (decision, outcome or note), tool name, record hash and status (signed only; co-signed; co-signed with the public timestamp pending; BLOCKED; or FAILED a check), then the total that matched, how many are shown and whether the list was truncated. Metadata only: the inputs and outputs of the tool calls are never returned, they stay in the local files (a person reads them with `npx signafaide replay`). Read-only: it writes nothing and sends no records. Each record is checked against its signature and its chain as it is listed; when records here have been co-signed, it fetches the service's public keys to check their receipts, and otherwise it makes no request. For the full check with PASS or FAIL use signafaide_verify; for counts per chain, the outbox and the quota use signafaide_status.

agent.description: Only this agent's records. Default: every agent with records here.

directory.description: Path of the project to work on: the folder the MCP server was started in, or one below it. Default: that folder.

from.description: Only records at or after this time: an ISO time such as 2026-11-13T10:00:00Z, or a date (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: The most records to return. Default 20; values above 100 are treated as 100.

record.description: A record hash, or its first 8 or more characters: returns that record and its paired decision or outcome.

to.description: Only records before this ISO time, or up to the end of this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: signafaide_records
title: List and search the signafAIde records on this machine
